title: Stage 6, running on Kubernetes: install, grow, upgrade, back up, see everything
description: Serves PRODUCT.md's road, stage 6: "Manifests and a Helm chart, growing and shrinking with demand, upgrades without downtime, backup." and "Nothing is hidden." A placeholder for the stage, to be split into tasks of one capability each before anything in it is built.
acceptanceCriteria: Plain manifests or a Helm chart, a Postgres and declared storage install it.
The cluster grows and shrinks with demand by itself, using the hardware the operator gives it.
Upgrades interrupt no one, and an Octave app nobody updated keeps working after one.
Backups are the Postgres and the stores the operator already backs up.
The operator sees who is watching what, how it is delivered and why, and follows any one playback from Play to its end; measurements don't grow with every job made.
notes: Coarse placeholder: never build as it stands. Split it when stage 6 is planned.
